title: Raw Idea Intake and Claim Assessment

placement.claim: The proposal meaning is approved with provisional placement as a dedicated planning-layer intake capability that owns attributed interpretation and claim-level assessment of exact raw-idea revisions while raw sources, proposal packets, claim history, and repository cleanup retain their separate owners.

reopening_conditions: Dogfooding shows that stable intake identity and provenance cannot survive practical source movement without changing the proposal-packet origin contract.
Claim assessment across duplicate, implemented, split, and novel ideas cannot share a truthful minimum without collapsing domain-specific judgments.
A separate top-level intake surface adds no meaningful retrieval, validation, or context-loading value over a clearly partitioned ideas hierarchy.
Formation repeatedly must reread the complete raw source or redo intake reconciliation because the proposed handoff omits material candidate meaning.
Observed consumers require transactional, concurrent, or external-evidence semantics that repository-local Git-backed artifacts cannot preserve.

authority.decision_owner: user or future explicitly authorized portfolio owner

relationships.rationale: Formation can consume a source-bound, claim-addressable candidate projection without owning raw capture, intake reconciliation, or cleanup, and owns immutable publication of each surviving complete packet before semantic review; intake readiness does not require every proposal to pass through this capability.
Intake records may become stable proposal origins while proposal packets retain proposal identity, current meaning, lifecycle, relationships, uncertainty, and decision authority.

Intake needs stable assessment-claim revisions, evidence baselines, and adjudicated relationship history, but this proposal does not select the experimental shared claim-lineage candidate as their permanent owner.
